description: Permanently delete a list, with all of its items and indexes. Unlike an item, a deleted list can't be restored. The list disappears at once (its pathName is free again) and its contents are purged in the background. A protected list that still has items is refused. Confirm with the user first. 1 request.

confirm.description: The same value as list, to confirm the deletion

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

name: delete_list
title: Delete a list
